title: Launch countdowns stop at 10-15 seconds with craft seen
summary: Mario Woods tells of Launch countdowns stop at 10-15 seconds with craft seen, about 1970s at Ellsworth missile field, South Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: get down to 10 or 15 seconds and it stops then everything's normal again crazy and people rolling up on these sites have sometimes seen those crafts and they blow away

plain: A man named Mario Woods, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about guards at nuclear missile sites, describes something he says happened in the 1970s in the missile field run from Ellsworth, an Air Force base in South Dakota. He says missile launch countdowns would run down to 10 or 15 seconds and then stop, after which everything was normal again, and that people driving up to the sites sometimes saw strange craft that then shot away. If true, it would mean unknown craft could reach into America's nuclear weapons.
